title: Drew Galloway’s breakthrough & Lashley’s knockout
summary: Drew Galloway ends Matt Hardy’s reign with his Feast or Fired opportunity. His celebration becomes a battle with Lashley, whose pursuit culminates in a knockout-or-submission title match.

chapters.title: Galloway cashes in
chapters.result: Drew Galloway defeats Matt Hardy to win the world title.
chapters.context: Galloway interrupts Hardy’s escape with the belt, uses his Feast or Fired case and celebrates his breakthrough among the fans.

chapters.title: Lashley wins by knockout
chapters.result: Lashley defeats Galloway for the world championship.
chapters.context: The knockout-or-submission stipulation gives Lashley a decisive way to end the reign and establish his dominance.
